edges.reason: _numNobody parameter controls how many tokens mint() requests.
_salt parameter seeds the DNA randomness used when minting.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mint().
maxNobody caps the total supply checked by mint().
maxNobodyPerPurchase limits the amount mintable in one call.
price is used to compute the required msg.value in mint().
isSaleActive gates execution of mint().
mint() delegates token creation to internal _mint().
_tokenId selects which Dudes token is claimed in claim().
msg.sender must equal theDudes.ownerOf(_tokenId); caller identity drives the claim authorization.
isClaimActive gates execution of claim().
claimedTokenIds is checked and written by claim() to prevent double claims.
claim() calls internal _claim() to mint the Nobody.
claim() performs external theDudes ownerOf and dudes calls.
_owner parameter determines whose tokens are claimed in claimAll().
claimAll() calls allClaimed() before looping.
claimAll() calls claimableOf() to enumerate claimable ids.
claimAll() loops and calls claim() for each claimable id.
isClaimActive gates execution of claimAll().
allClaimed() calls claimableOf() internally.
claimableOf() relies on external theDudes tokensOfOwner and ownerOf calls.
claimableOf() reads claimedTokenIds to filter already claimed tokens.
_to parameter is the recipient passed to _safeMint inside _claim().
_claim() writes the generated DNA into the nobody mapping.
_claim() mints the token via _safeMint().
_claim() uses _substring() when composing the Nobody DNA.
mintIndex local tracks totalSupply() during the _mint loop.
mintIndex local tracks totalSupply() inside _claim().
nobodyid local stores the generated DNA in _mint().
nobodyid local stores the generated DNA in _claim().
_mint() calls _getNobody() to generate DNA.
_mint() calls _safeMint() for each generated token.
_mint() compares totalSupply() against maxNobody.
_mint() writes the generated DNA into the nobody mapping.
_claim() compares totalSupply() against maxNobody.
nonce is read inside _random() as randomness entropy.
_random() mutates the nonce state variable on every call.
block.timestamp seeds _random(), making generation dependent on miner-controlled time.
msg.sender is part of the _random() seed, so the caller can influence randomness.
local r holds the pseudorandom value produced by _random().
_getNobody() calls _random() while assembling DNA.
_findTraits() calls _random() for trait selection.
_getNobody() calls _findTraits() once per trait category.
foundDNAs is read and written by _getNobody() to avoid duplicates.
reservetheudes() writes entries into the foundDNAs mapping.
reservetheudes() calls external thedudes.dudes() in a loop.
withdraw() performs a native value transfer of the entire balance.
balance local receives address(this).balance in withdraw().
msg.sender is the recipient of the native transfer in withdraw().
reserveNobody() delegates to internal _mint().
creator receives the initially reserved token via _mint in the constructor.
_safeMint() calls _checkOnERC721Received() after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received() invokes the recipient's onERC721Received external callback.
The recipient callback can re-enter ERC721 transfer/mint logic before state is fully settled.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize flipSaleState().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize flipClaimState().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize withdraw().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize reserveNobody().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize reservetheudes().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize setPrice().
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize setBaseURI().
_newPrice parameter is written into the price state variable.
_newBaseURI parameter is written into the baseURI state variable.
setPrice() overwrites the price state variable.
setBaseURI() writes the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI() reads baseURI through _baseURI().
tokenURI() reads nobody[_tokenId] to build the metadata URI.
newOwner parameter is the target of transferOwnership().
transferOwnership() writes the _owner state variable controlling access.
renounceOwnership() sets _owner to the zero address, removing access control.
flipSaleState() toggles the isSaleActive state variable.
flipClaimState() toggles the isClaimActive state variable.
The thedudescontract state variable is the target of the external calls.
Trait pools configured by _setTraitTable() are consumed by _findTraits().

normalization_plan.reason: _numNobody is a transient input of mint() and carries no independent semantic value.
_salt is a transient randomness input of mint() and should be folded into the caller function.
_tokenId is a transient input of claim() used only for the ownership check and lookup.
_owner is a transient account argument of claimAll()/claimableOf used only for enumeration.
_to is a transient recipient argument of the internal _claim().
_newPrice is a transient argument whose only effect is writing the price state variable.
_newBaseURI is a transient argument whose only effect is writing the baseURI state variable.
newOwner is a transient argument whose only effect is writing the _owner state variable.
mintIndex is a loop-local cache of totalSupply() inside _mint()/_claim().
nobodyid is a short-lived DNA string stored in the nobody mapping during minting.
balance is a transient cache of address(this).balance inside withdraw().
r is a transient intermediate result returned by _random().
